record.student_summary: You can do your summer computer science internship as CPT once your department confirms it counts for credit. We will extend your I-20 to December 15, 2027 so your June 1 to August 15 full-time dates are covered. Send your offer letter today and wait for your new I-20 before starting work. For your winter trip to Ghana, get a travel signature before you leave and plan to renew your visa if it will be expired when you return. This one summer of full-time CPT should still leave you able to do OPT after you graduate.
